name: @pipeworx/mcp-quiver

tools.name: quiver_congress_trading
tools.description: Recent US Congress stock trades — who in Congress bought/sold what, with amount ranges and disclosure dates. Pass a ticker to get the trade history for that company instead ("Congress trades for TSLA"). Example: quiver_congress_trading({ ticker: "NVDA", _apiKey: "your-key" })

ticker.description: Optional stock ticker to filter to one company, e.g. "NVDA". Omit for the latest cross-market feed.

_apiKey.description: Quiver Quantitative API key (get one at quiverquant.com; Hobbyist plan from $30/mo)

tools.name: quiver_gov_contracts
tools.description: Government contracts awarded (by ticker) — US federal contract awards to public companies, with award amount, agency, and date. Pass a ticker for that company's contract history ("government contracts for LMT"). Example: quiver_gov_contracts({ ticker: "LMT", _apiKey: "your-key" })

ticker.description: Optional stock ticker to filter to one company, e.g. "LMT". Omit for the latest cross-market feed.

tools.name: quiver_lobbying
tools.description: Corporate lobbying disclosures for <ticker> — federal lobbying spend filed by a public company, with client, amount, date, and issue. Example: quiver_lobbying({ ticker: "GOOGL", _apiKey: "your-key" })

ticker.description: Stock ticker to look up lobbying for, e.g. "GOOGL" (required)

tools.name: quiver_insiders
tools.description: SEC insider (Form 4) transactions for <ticker> — corporate insider buys/sells at a public company, with insider name, share count, and date. Example: quiver_insiders({ ticker: "AAPL", _apiKey: "your-key" })

ticker.description: Stock ticker to look up insider transactions for, e.g. "AAPL" (required)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-quiver forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the quiver pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
